sources.title: Open-Inspect README.md
sources.finding: Self-deployed background coding system has web/chat/Git integrations, multiplayer prompting, per-session sandboxes and subtask spawning. Designed for one trusted organization, not tenant isolation.

sources.title: Open-Inspect docs/SETUP_GUIDE.md
sources.locator: Deployment paths; Path C; Important context; related guides
sources.finding: The setup guide offers running the web app against an existing backend, local contribution, or a full self-hosted deployment, and links a guide for running the control plane in a container without Cloudflare. GitHub App repository credentials are required, and GitHub/Google sign-in is distinct from them. Deployment is single-tenant.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/models/agent-harnesses.mdx
sources.finding: Sessions choose OpenCode, Claude Agent SDK or Codex for their lifetime. Children inherit harness. Claude subscriptions require Claude Agent; model choice is not native Grok CLI support.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/models/provider-accounts.mdx
sources.finding: Connected Claude, ChatGPT/Codex and SuperGrok accounts or API credentials have provider defaults, identity/status and unattended policy. Subscription routes have harness-specific restrictions.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/sessions/child-sessions.mdx
sources.finding: Product tools spawn independent child sandboxes/branches, send follow-ups, inspect responses/events and cancel descendants. Default limits are five concurrent and fifteen total children per parent; depth is bounded.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/sessions/multiplayer-and-sharing.mdx
sources.finding: Authorized different people can prompt/stop the same session, share its timeline/sandbox and queue follow-ups. Commit attribution follows prompt authors. Team read isolation requires enforcement on; default is shadow.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/administration/workspace-access.mdx
sources.finding: Owner, Administrator, Member and Viewer have named permissions; private/team session action checks add resource-specific access boundaries. Viewer lacks prompting/sandbox access.

sources.title: Open-Inspect docs/AUTH.md
sources.finding: Workspace role checks, private collaborator grants and current team membership govern operations. GitHub credentials are App/session-scoped; snapshot-cached credentials and issued-token revocation limits remain documented.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/configure/sandbox-providers.mdx
sources.finding: Operator selects Modal, modal-vm, Daytona, Vercel, E2B or Boat. Provider-specific snapshots/resume, CPU/RAM and timeout limits differ. Boat is a persistent full-VM sandbox; default Modal is not Docker-capable.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/sessions/reviewing-changes.mdx
sources.finding: Session Changes view displays committed/uncommitted diffs, file filters and exact comparison context. Timeline retains screenshots, recordings and command output; PR review is a separate GitHub action.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/sessions/spend-limits.mdx
sources.finding: Reported model spend has workspace/repo/environment/session limits. Exhaustion stops work and blocks prompts until owner raises/removes the limit. Subscription costs are informational estimates; unreported usage cannot be bounded.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/integrations/mcp-server.mdx
sources.finding: Locally built MCP server reads sessions/diffs/automation history and optionally creates/triggers automation/imports skills through scoped PATs, bounded by the users role.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/configure/mcp-servers.mdx
sources.finding: Managed MCP connections have shared/personal scopes and authenticated control-plane proxying. Harness-specific loading restrictions remain.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/configure/memories.mdx
sources.finding: Repository/session memory stores provide scoped durable records and explicit mutation/search controls; memory is separate from task-spec approval.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/automations/index.mdx
sources.finding: Server automation starts sessions from cron, inbound webhook, Sentry, Slack or deployed GitHub bot events. Three consecutive failures pause it; Linear automation events are planned, not current.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/administration/data-controls.mdx
sources.finding: Web supports archiving/restoration, not deletion controls. Operator/service NDJSON export includes optional traces/events/usage but is best-effort, not a consistent backup.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/administration/audit-log.mdx
sources.finding: Owner/admin read-only event UI distinguishes applied/no-change/denied/rejected operation outcomes from allowed authorization decisions, with actor/resource snapshots and structured details.

sources.title: Open-Inspect packages/docs/content/docs/reference/limits.mdx
sources.locator: Sessions; Boot and sandbox; Automations; MCP
sources.finding: Documented session/child/sandbox and automation ceilings vary by configuration/provider; numeric limits are not a tested fleet capacity claim.

sources.title: Open-Inspect Claude Agent harness, credential flow
sources.finding: The Claude Agent harness launches the claude binary inside the sandbox through a clean-credential wrapper that passes a single Anthropic credential, either an API key or a connected Claude account token.
